title: Find and fix the intermittent invoice request timeouts
goal: Invoice list and detail requests never time out under the load of a full e2e run on a local stack.
why: Seen in three separate runs (2026-10-20/21): invoices.spec failures in two full suites and the locale spec, all "Request timeout" on invoice list/detail, passing when re-run alone.
steps: Reproduce: run the full e2e suite on a single-tenant stack with request timing logged (API side: per-request duration and the slowest middleware/handler steps; client side: which invoice requests time out and the client timeout value).

Find the root cause (slow query without an index, N+1 lookups in middleware, a blocking external call, client timeout too short for a legitimately slow call, request storms from the page) and fix it at the cause; add a test that guards it (e.g. query plan uses an index, request count per page load).
Do not just raise timeouts unless the evidence shows the timeout itself is wrong; say which.
tests: a guard for the root cause
acceptance: two full e2e runs with no invoice timeouts
gate: two full e2e runs on slot 0
